meta.labeling: entry=close[i]; SL=entry-/+k*ATR14[i]; TP=entry+/-rr*k*ATR14[i]; k=1.5, rr=1.5; scan next <=50 bars; TP-first=win; same-bar TP&SL counted as SL (conservative); timeout=mark-to-market at last close of horizon, scaled by SL distance
meta.indicators: EMA=ewm(span,adjust=False); ATR=SMA14(TrueRange); RSI=SMA14 gains/losses with loss floor 1e-5 (copied from daytrad/core/indicators.py)
meta.time_convention: stored CSV timestamps treated as UTC+7 and shifted -7h to UTC (evidence in report)
meta.p_value_note: two-proportion z-test vs dataset baseline, nominal only; samples overlap heavily
